name: ScopeDimension
description: The dimensions along which a role assignment can be narrowed. A dimension names a column that resources are grouped by; which resource that is, is part of the dimension's meaning and is written here.

values.name: CREATION_GROUP
values.description: Which creation groups a contribution carries. A contribution has zero or more, so it is covered when any of them is in the set. target_id 0 covers contributions with none.

values.name: COMMUNITY
values.description: Which community a resource belongs to. target_id 0 has no meaning here — every resource has a community.

notes: Adding a dimension is a value here plus one line where the resource's value is read. No table, no migration, and nothing in the four database implementations changes.

An unknown dimension is dropped when the cache is built and logged at warn: a scope an implementation does not understand must not silently widen or narrow anything, and dropping the row leaves that dimension unrestricted only if no other row for it survives — which is the same as the admin never having set it.
A dimension is an identifier and follows the rule the rest of contracts/ follows: rename nothing, reuse nothing.
